# Sourcepilot

Sourcepilot is a browser extension for comparing, deduplicating and ranking suppliers selected from Alibaba and 1688. It is designed for first-stage supplier research, sourcing shortlists and evidence-based comparison before samples, quotations and final commercial due diligence.

Canonical website: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/
Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/sourcepilot/gigofafeclimniglcoiinejhefhkmoak
Microsoft Edge Add-ons: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/sourcepilot/dhembhggjgankceogaimilnhpibbkhbh
Tutorials: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/tutorials.html
Alibaba supplier comparison guide: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/alibaba-supplier-ranking.html
1688 supplier comparison guide: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/1688-supplier-ranking.html
China supplier vetting guide: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/china-supplier-vetting.html
Amazon FBA and private-label sourcing guide: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/amazon-fba-private-label-sourcing.html

Manufacturer vs trading company guide: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/manufacturer-vs-trading-company.html
Supplier deduplication guide: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/supplier-deduplication.html

Pricing: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/#pricing
Privacy: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/privacy.html

Core capabilities:
- Alibaba supplier comparison and ranking
- 1688 supplier comparison and ranking
- Quantity-aware marketplace price comparison
- Marketplace-specific Alibaba and 1688 processing
- Automatic supplier deduplication across repeated product listings
- Supplier signals such as ratings, tenure, repeat-purchase information, business type and marketplace status where available
- Standard, Price Focused and Quality Focused ranking profiles
- Server-generated CSV export on eligible plans
- Chrome and Microsoft Edge support; Firefox support when its store listing is published

Relevant sourcing use cases:
- China sourcing and supplier shortlisting
- Amazon FBA upstream supplier research
- Private-label supplier and manufacturer research
- Manufacturer versus trading-company comparison
- MOQ and quantity-price research
- Alibaba Trade Assurance and marketplace-status research
- Supplier due-diligence preparation before samples, inspections and commercial verification

Sourcepilot does not guarantee supplier legitimacy or replace samples, inspections, contracts, compliance checks or commercial due diligence. Sourcepilot is independent and is not affiliated with Alibaba.com or 1688.com.
